event.desc: Composed poetry on the book 『Majmūʿ al-Badrī』. The opening lines are: 'Lillāhi majmūʿun lahu qad tashhadu al-majāmiʿu / bi-annahu quṭbun lahā niʿma wa-fardun jāmiʿun.'
event.note: Al-Badrī = Abū Bakr b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Muḥammad b. Aḥmad, Taqī al-Dīn Ibn al-Badrī, Abū al-Tuqā, the poet (AIND-D10718; cf. the nisbah entry AIND-D11661-band "al-Badrī" AIND-D11470 and the corpus stub "Abū al-Tuqā al-Badrī al-shāʿir"). His majmūʿ, on which many contemporaries wrote taqārīẓ, is registered as TMP-T-00115 (new).

person.note: ハサン・ブン・ジューディー・アル＝マーリディーニー。彼には『アル＝バドリーの集成（マジュムーウ）』に寄せた詩がある。その冒頭は「なんと見事な、彼の集成よ。諸々の集成がこぞって証言する、それこそが集成の枢軸、まことに唯一無二の包括者であると」。そして彼の筆跡は見事である。

Al-Ḥasan b. Jūdī al-Māridīnī composed poetry on the book 『Majmūʿ al-Badrī』. Its opening lines are: 'To God belongs a collection of his — the collections themselves bear witness / that it is their pole; indeed, a uniquely comprehensive one.' His handwriting was also excellent.
